name: StoneYield USD
oneLiner: stUSD is StoneYield's BNB Chain yield wrapper over USDC routed through a Venus-linked strategy layer; tracked as a managed wrapper, not a plain fiat stablecoin.
collateral: USDC and yield-bearing USDC positions routed through StoneYield's protocol contracts and Venus-linked strategy layer
pegMechanism: StoneYield wrapper token designed to maintain one-dollar accounting against deposited stablecoin assets while strategy yield accrues through the protocol's managed vault structure

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: StoneYield USD is a managed yield wrapper on BNB Chain; docs identify protocol controls, but available sources do not prove an active holder-balance blacklist function.

reserves.name: USDC and yield-bearing USDC strategy positions

mintAuthority.summary: stUSD is StoneYield's strategy-vault wrapper over USDC routed through a Venus-linked strategy layer; shares are minted against USDC deposits and do not create base USDC supply, so its mint authority is inherited from USDC (usdc-circle).

controls.label: StoneYield stUSD wrapper token
controls.capDescription: stUSD shares are minted/burned by the StoneYield vault against USDC deposits and withdrawals; this share accounting cannot create or destroy base USDC supply.
controls.evidence: Strategy-vault receipt: stUSD shares represent a claim on USDC routed through StoneYield's Venus-linked strategy; minting shares only follows USDC deposits and does not expand the parent USDC monetary base.

controls.label: Inherited USDC (Circle) issuer mint path
controls.evidence: Underlying USDC supply is issuer-minted by Circle via the MasterMinter and token owner/admin (issuer-direct-mint, concentrated-admin); this wrapper holds USDC and inherits that base mint authority.

review.evidence: stUSD (variantOf usdc-circle, variantKind strategy-vault) is a StoneYield yield wrapper whose shares track deposited USDC; base mint authority is the inherited Circle USDC issuer path (concentrated-admin) and is mirrored here.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Wrapper/strategy-vault classification follows from coin metadata (variantOf usdc-circle, strategy-vault, wrapper reserve); posture mirrors the verified USDC parent mint authority.

notices.title: Yield wrapper, not a plain cash stablecoin
notices.message: stUSD is tracked because CoinGecko returns a live price and market cap, but its structure is a managed yield wrapper around stablecoin strategies rather than a simple fiat-backed dollar token.
